description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**

You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**IN THIS ROLE** – Drive end-to-end data product delivery by combining Agile discipline with structured project management. Own sprint workflows, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment for timely data product delivery. Break through blockers and orchestrate cross-team dependencies across engineering, governance, data product and operations teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** — Strong servant leadership; exceptional facilitation skills; ability to balance agile flexibility with governance rigor; experience in both Scrum and structured project delivery. A passion for driving adoption of PMO standards and continuous improvement across delivery teams.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**:

* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned data products — plan, execute, and close projects within scope, time and budget
* Manage project teams, stakeholders and inter-team dependencies to ensure delivery aligns with product stream strategy and portfolio objectives
* Facilitate sprint ceremonies & ensure the agile methodology is consistently followed by all team members
* Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, manage team workflows, flag risks, and remove delivery blockers
* Develop and maintain project artefacts, including the project charter, work plan, RACI, and RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Decisions) across data product lifecycle phases.
* Track deliverable completion and sign-offs (HLD, DIF/DOF, STTM mapping, pipeline builds)
* Facilitate project meetings and ensure continuous, transparent communication across teams
* Escalate impediments to the Data Product Manager with clear impact assessment and recommended actions
* Coordinate test execution, track defects and resolution progress to meet the success criteria
* Provide proactive support during UAT, CAB preparation, hypercare phases, and ensure a smooth deployment workflow
* Drive adoption of PMO best practices, agile principles, retrospective outcomes, and process improvements to increase delivery efficiency and quality
* Maintain delivery metrics (velocity, burn-down/burn-up, cycle time, defect rates) and produce executive-level status updates for leadership and governance forums

**SPECIFIC SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or related field
* 7+ years as Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Project Manager
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II)
* Proven experience managing data engineering or data platform delivery programs end-to-end
* Strong proficiency in Agile methodology and experience with Agile/DevOps Tools: Jira Software, GitHub
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* PMP or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or SAF RAID loge Agilist (SA) certification
* Experience with scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe) and PI Planning
* Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines in a data delivery context
* Familiarity with DBx-based data platform delivery environments
* Background in FMCG/CPG enterprise environments

* Familiarity with AI-driven and agentic delivery models

* Knowledge of data governance processes
* Experience with ITIL change management frameworks

No Relocation support available

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  
  

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**
----------------------------------------

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194006

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Role**
------------------

The Scrum Master (SM) ensures the way of working enables delivery within Avaya’s CI/CD Feature Team model. This role owns flow health, process discipline, and continuous improvement — protecting the team’s ability to deliver continuously through WIP discipline, impediment removal, and ensuring Jira reflects execution reality, not planning aspiration. Avaya keeps the customer at the core. The SM protects flow so the team can deliver customer-valuable increments continuously. This role facilitates, coaches, and removes impediments. It partners closely with the Product Owner (PO), Delivery and Execution Lead (DEL), Technical Lead (TL), and PLM (Analyst). It does not own backlog content/acceptance, delivery-commitment outcomes, product prioritization, technical decisions, or release Go/No-Go.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies (Daily Flow/standup, Planning, Refinement, Review, Retrospective, Demo) that produce decisions and momentum
* Enforce WIP limits and working agreements to protect flow and prevent overcommitment
* Remove team-level and systemic impediments; escalate what the team cannot resolve alone
* Keep Jira (and Zephyr-related progress signals) accurate and trustworthy — daily, no exceptions
* Use flow metrics (cycle time, throughput, blocked time) to drive continuous improvement
* Partner with PO on readiness and sprint-commitment alignment; TL on technical/pipeline impediments; DEL on cross-team/systemic escalation; PLM on requirement clarity impacting flow
* Coach the team on sustainable pace, psychological safety, and customer-aware delivery conversations - without taking product ownership
* Use AI (Tier 2 — Practitioner) to accelerate sprint-health, flow, and retrospective prep; remain accountable for facilitation judgment and data integrity

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong background in Agile ways of working; familiarity with Scrum, SAFe, ICAgile, Scrum Alliance, and/or related certifications / continuing education
* Work-item tracking experience — Jira preferred, or comparable tools (Rally, Azure DevOps/ADO)
* Proficiency in Google Workspace preferred, or equivalent Microsoft Office fluency
* Proven ceremony facilitation and coaching craft (Powerful Questions, Active Listening, constructive collaboration)
* Flow and metrics literacy; demonstrated continuous-improvement follow-through
* Strong stakeholder communication and conflict navigation under delivery pressure
* Comfort using AI tools to support facilitation and metrics prep, with human accountability for decisions and board accuracy

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* Predictable flow with consistent throughput and minimal blocked work
* Trustworthy, current Jira/Zephyr data
* Continuous improvement that is visible and actionable
* Sprint objectives supported through strong process facilitation — without the SM becoming a task manager, delivery owner, or people manager

**Experience**
--------------

9+ Years of Experience

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field

**Footer**
----------

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. description:

Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Data and Reporting team is focused on unlocking the value of data as it exists within AkzoNobel systems. We're an eclectic team of data-oriented doers who love to take on new challenges, are always learning, and looking for ways to improve decision-making.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Design, develop, test, and implement IT solutions and processes in IT systems like applications, platforms and networks through IT changes, projects in line with global Information Technology (IT) and security guidelines, to support company business requirements to create company value.

The **Functional** **Engineer in Application Delivery** is responsible for detailing design and hardwiring business requirements as per Architectural and Security guidelines. This is done through projects, changes and increasingly more through Agile Devops teams. This requires high quality Stories (change specifications) and projects changes which will allow Engineers and/or Developers to translate into code/configuration. The Functional Engineer sees to properly coordinate, review, approve and execute stories/project changes and has an active role monitoring status, in (unit)testing and change management once developed, including organizing sign-off after testing.

The Functional Engineer has an active role in the preparation and execution of the actual changes together with our partners and external consultants where applicable.

On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.

Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.

**Key Activities**
------------------

**Story specification**

Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.

**Development & delivery**

Guide, coordinate and oversee the preparation and execution and implementation of the (project) changes and the development of the code/config of Stories. Ensure that all partners follow established standards (process- & documentation standards, coding and testing standards, naming conventions etc.). Review, Approve and control the implementation and/or embedding of new, enhancements and/or modifications of applications, systems and/or solutions.

This results in building sustainable and stable first-time right solutions in a very collaborate team spirit (also with external service providers) and in an engaging way with stakeholders and consumers of the solutions. Solutions are built according to the Architectural and Security principles and changes are timely & adequately prepared & documented and/or code works as intended.

**Testing**

Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.

Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.

**Incident management**

Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.

**Process management and improvement**

Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Has a good view of the technical state of the application (technical debt) and regularly discuss and works seamlessly together with the (domain)Architect to develop plans to resolve the technical debt.

Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.

Support a project manager by taking ownership of specific project deliverables (specifications, config, testing, etc). Define, plan, manage and participate in assigned project deliverables from the own functional or technical domain, in accordance with the IT project manager and involved business project owners. Resulting in, efficient and effective realization of project deliverables.

**Experience**

**Project Management:** Should be able to independently manage several projects, track actions and reach out to stakeholders when needed.

**Solution design & development:**

Develop new solution using BI Tools (Power BI)

* Translate business logic to technical calculations that will help the technical team to build the metrics

* Educate and train a variety of stakeholders about the dashboard technicalities & features
